whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Yo’z Pizza,

I noticed your pizzeria has fantastic 4.7★ reviews in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and delivery website for local customers.

Maine aapke pizza outlet ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, crust/topping customization, aur store timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/yoz

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Yo'z Pizza, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke outlet ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top-rated pizzas in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, prices, aur online ordering setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
